name: IPCC Shared Socioeconomic Pathways Model
description: Simplified model of the IPCC Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) framework showing population, GDP, energy demand, and emissions trajectories under different development scenarios. Based on IPCC AR6 scenarios.

variables.name: Population Growth Rate
variables.equation: IF SSP_Scenario = 1 THEN 0.003 ELSE IF SSP_Scenario = 2 THEN 0.008 ELSE IF SSP_Scenario = 3 THEN 0.012 ELSE IF SSP_Scenario = 4 THEN 0.01 ELSE 0.005

variables.name: GDP Growth Rate
variables.equation: IF SSP_Scenario = 1 THEN 0.025 ELSE IF SSP_Scenario = 2 THEN 0.02 ELSE IF SSP_Scenario = 3 THEN 0.015 ELSE IF SSP_Scenario = 4 THEN 0.018 ELSE 0.02

variables.name: Energy Efficiency Rate
variables.equation: IF SSP_Scenario = 1 THEN 0.025 ELSE IF SSP_Scenario = 2 THEN 0.015 ELSE IF SSP_Scenario = 3 THEN 0.005 ELSE IF SSP_Scenario = 4 THEN 0.01 ELSE 0.02

variables.name: Decarbonization Rate
variables.equation: IF SSP_Scenario = 1 THEN 0.03 ELSE IF SSP_Scenario = 2 THEN 0.02 ELSE IF SSP_Scenario = 3 THEN 0.005 ELSE IF SSP_Scenario = 4 THEN 0.01 ELSE 0.025

reference: Riahi K et al. The Shared Socioeconomic Pathways and their energy, land use, and greenhouse gas emissions implications. Global Environmental Change. 2017;42:153-168.
